title.zh: 将卡林阿省塔布克市描笼涯 Calanan 的安东尼奥·卡纳奥桥起，经描笼涯 Bulanao 与 Ipil，至同属卡林阿省塔布克市描笼涯 Nambaran 的 Alliog 桥止的高山省边界—卡兰安—恩里莱公路路段更名为曼努埃尔·S·阿吉奥大道的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Portion of the Mountain Province Boundary-Calanan-Enrile Road, Stretching From the Antonio Canao Bridge in Barangay Calanan, Traversing Through Barangays Bulanao and Ipil, Up to the Alliog Bridge in Barangay Nambaran, All in the City of Tabuk in the Province of Kalinga, as Manuel S. Agyao Boulevard

Agyao Boulevard
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên đoạn Đường ranh giới Tỉnh Mountain–Calanan–Enrile kéo dài từ Cầu Antonio Canao tại Barangay Calanan, đi qua Barangay Bulanao và Barangay Ipil, đến Cầu Alliog tại Barangay Nambaran, tất cả đều thuộc Thành phố Tabuk, Tỉnh Kalinga thành Đại lộ Manuel S. Agyao
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อส่วนของถนนแนวเขตจังหวัดเมาเทนพรอวินซ์–คาลานัน–เอ็นริเล่เริ่มต้นจากสะพานอันโตนิโอคาเนาในบารังไกย์คาลานันผ่านบารังไกย์บูลาเนาและอิปิลจนถึงสะพานอัลลิโอคในบารังไกย์นัมบารันซึ่งทั้งหมดอยู่ในนครตาบุกจังหวัดกาลิงกาเป็นถนนมานูเอลเอสอะเกียว
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengganti Nama Ruas Jalan Batas Provinsi Mountain–Calanan–Enrile yang Membentang dari Jembatan Antonio Canao di Barangay Calanan, Melintasi Barangay Bulanao dan Barangay Ipil, Sampai ke Jembatan Alliog di Barangay Nambaran, Semuanya di Kota Tabuk, Provinsi Kalinga, Menjadi Boulevard Manuel S. Agyao
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Bahagian Jalan Sempadan Negeri Mountain–Calanan–Enrile yang Membentang dari Jambatan Antonio Canao di Barangay Calanan, Melalui Barangay Bulanao dan Barangay Ipil, Hingga ke Jambatan Alliog di Barangay Nambaran, Semuanya di Bandar Tabuk, Wilayah Kalinga, Menjadi Lebuh Manuel S. Agyao

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2021/ra_11603_2021.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The portion of the Mountain Province Boundary-Calanan-Enrile Road, stretching from the Antonio Canao Bridge in Barangay Calanan, traversing through barangays Bulanao and Ipil, up to the Alliog Bridge in Barangay Nambaran, all in the City of Tabuk in the Province of Kalinga, is hereby renamed as Manuel S. Agyao Boulevard.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders, and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act within sixty (60) from its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
